# Masab Farooque — Full Stack Developer & AI Engineer

> Masab Farooque is a Level 2 Fiverr Seller and full stack developer from Islamabad, Pakistan. He builds SaaS platforms, AI pipelines, web scrapers, and full stack web applications for clients across 15 countries. 195 plus completed orders since 2023.

## About

Masab Farooque graduated from COMSATS University Islamabad with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science in January 2023. During university he worked as a Unity game developer at 10Static Studios and completed three internships at Mindstorm Studios, where he won the Best Mechanics Award at the Rookie Game Jam 2022 and placed runner-up at Developers Game Jam 2.0. He also won The Hustler Award at Epiphany Games in 2020 and participated in seven national game jams across Pakistan.

After graduating in 2023 he transitioned fully into web development and AI engineering. He reached Level 2 seller status on Fiverr with 195 plus completed orders. He also founded ReplayJutsu, an online gaming publication that grew to 100,000 plus monthly active users, and worked as an SEO Web Developer at PentaByteX from July 2024 to February 2025.

He is a solo developer, not a team or agency. Every project is designed, built, and deployed by him.

## Services

Masab provides four core service categories:

### Full Stack Development
Complete web applications from database to UI. React, Next.js, Node.js, and NestJS on the frontend and backend. PostgreSQL via Supabase for data, Redis for caching, Docker for deployment. Projects include SaaS platforms, e-commerce systems, client portals, and MVPs.

### AI and Machine Learning Integration
LangChain and LangGraph agents, RAG pipelines with vector databases, OpenAI and Anthropic integrations, AI chatbots with conversation memory, and multi-step workflow automation. Full production-grade AI systems with circuit breakers, caching, and structured logging.

### Web Scraping and Automation
Custom web scrapers using Playwright, Selenium, and Puppeteer. Celery and Redis for distributed task queuing. Anti-bot bypass, pagination handling, and clean structured data output. Browser automation for login flows, form submissions, and file downloads.

### API Development
FastAPI and NestJS REST APIs with OpenAPI documentation, JWT authentication, role-based access, and consistent error handling. Third-party integrations with Stripe, Telegram, Twilio, and Google APIs. Performance optimization with Redis caching and connection pooling.

## Featured Projects

### Navia
A rare disease intelligence platform aggregating data from nine global medical sources. Backend handles 460,000 plus clinical trials, 270,000 plus publications, and 10,000 plus diseases. Built with Next.js 14, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Celery, Redis, and OpenAI. Includes Stripe subscriptions, GDPR compliance, and an admin BI dashboard.
Live: https://navia.health

### FirstDeal
A full stack SaaS platform for the Dutch and German second-hand car market. Monitors Marktplaats, 2dehands.be, and Kleinanzeigen in real time with instant Telegram and email alerts. Built with Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, and Stripe. Three pricing tiers, admin panel, referral system, PWA support.
Live: https://firstdeal.nl

### Hice.AI
A multi-tenant AI business management platform. LangChain agents handle natural language commands for HR, time tracking, and reporting. Row-level security via Supabase. Docker deployed.
Live: https://app.hice.ai

### Javea Denia Rentals
A vehicle rental platform for tourists on Costa Blanca. Real-time availability, Stripe payments, multi-language support, and admin dashboard.
Live: https://www.javea-denia-rentals.com

### JANUA Financial
An enterprise financial analysis tool for European businesses. OCR from PDFs, 50 plus financial ratios, Altman Z-Score, and professional PDF report generation.
Live: https://janua-financial-analysis-rho.vercel.app

### RotiShoti AI
An AI-powered food discovery platform for Pakistani cuisine. Semantic search, natural language queries, location-aware recommendations, and Groq LLaMA models for fast responses.

### Apple Music Metadata Validator
A React web app for VerseOne that validates music metadata files before Apple Music submission. Parses iMusician CSV and Excel formats, checks Apple style guide rules, detects duplicates by title, artist, and ISRC.

## Tech Stack

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Framer Motion
Backend: FastAPI, Node.js, NestJS, Express.js
AI and ML: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LangGraph, pgvector, RAG pipelines, Groq
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis, SQLite
Automation: Celery, Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer
DevOps: Docker, Vercel, Hostinger Node.js, GitHub
Payments: Stripe
Other: Telegram API, Twilio, Google APIs, JWT, OAuth
